title: Motor Carrier Census - for-hire cohort survival by registration year, Chicago 8 counties
claim: Share of for-hire USDOT registrations still Active with MCS-150 2024+: 2015 26.1% (539/2,069); 2016 26.7%; 2018 31.9% (936/2,938); 2019 33.1%; 2021 29.2% (1,882/6,454); 2022 30.2%; 2023 40.1% (1,463/3,645); 2024 68.5%. Survival flattens after ~5 years: implied exit among 5-10-year-old carriers ~6-7%/yr.
excerpt: Grouped count queries by substring(add_date,1,4), classdef like AUTHORIZED FOR HIRE.
limitations: Cross-sectional cohorts with different composition (2020-22 boom); 'inactive' can also mean merged/renamed; derived hazard is analyst arithmetic (E) on A data.

title: Motor Carrier Census - private-property fleets, Chicago 8 counties
claim: Private-property-only carriers (MCS-150 2024+): 528 with 10-100 PU (mean 28 PU); 1,009 with 5-100 PU; 106 of those with trade-service names (plumbing/HVAC/electric/landscape/tree/roofing/linen/fire/garage door).
excerpt: Same pull, classdef starts PRIVATE PROPERTY without for-hire authority.
limitations: Only vehicles that require a USDOT number are counted; light vans <10,001 lb GVWR in purely intrastate use are invisible, so fleet sizes are a floor.
